definitions.explanation: One particular feature or way of looking at something; a perspective.
The side surface of something; lateral part.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}の{別|べつ}の{側面|そくめん}を{見|み}る。
examples.english: To see another aspect of the problem.

examples.japanese: この{政策|せいさく}には{経済的|けいざいてき}な{側面|そくめん}もある。
examples.english: This policy also has an economic aspect.

examples.japanese: {文化|ぶんか}には{様々|さまざま}な{側面|そくめん}があり、{一|ひと}つの{見方|みかた}だけでは{理解|りかい}できない。
examples.english: Culture has various aspects and cannot be understood from just one perspective.

examples.japanese: {建物|たてもの}の{側面|そくめん}に{入口|いりぐち}がある。
examples.english: There's an entrance on the side of the building.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}の{側面|そくめん}に{傷|きず}がついた。
examples.english: There's a scratch on the side of the car.

examples.japanese: {箱|はこ}の{側面|そくめん}に{名前|なまえ}が{書|か}いてある。
examples.english: There's a name written on the side of the box.

notes:
{側面|そくめん} has both a physical meaning (the side of an object) and a figurative meaning (an aspect or facet of something). The figurative use is more common in everyday language.

SENSE 1 — FIGURATIVE (aspect, facet):
- {別|べつ}の{側面|そくめん}: another aspect
- {側面|そくめん}から{見|み}る: to view from another angle
- {側面|そくめん}を{持|も}つ: to have an aspect
- {経済的|けいざいてき}な{側面|そくめん}: economic aspect
- {心理的|しんりてき}な{側面|そくめん}: psychological aspect

SENSE 2 — PHYSICAL (side, flank):
- {建物|たてもの}の{側面|そくめん}: side of a building
- {車|くるま}の{側面|そくめん}: side of a car
- {側面|そくめん}{衝突|しょうとつ}: side-on collision

CONTRAST:
- {側面|そくめん}: side, aspect (concrete or abstract)
- {面|めん}: face, aspect (broader, more general)
- {観点|かんてん}: viewpoint, perspective (from which one looks)
- {局面|きょくめん}: phase, situation (of events or developments)
